title: refactor(ui)!: retire `@object-ui/plugin-ai` and its three node types
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ81VrFexr8r2XyceuMm7ZUF6)_

Part of #25921 (the plugin-ai item only; the card's other items stay open).
Supersedes #26365 (its commits are carried here unchanged, then `main` merged and the changeset finished).
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #27048 (the two `skills/objectui/guides/*` mentions, kept out of this PR by ruling 6439038287)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删除没有任何加载者的 `@object-ui/plugin-ai` 包；十个语言包删掉它的 `ai.*` 文案块；`@object-ui/types` 里它的类型/zod 镜像改为 `@deprecated` 的 `never` 墓碑，三个节点类型按名拒收并给出处方。changeset 改用整包操作数 `@object-ui/plugin-ai#*`。
- 为什么改：执行 #25921 的裁决 A（6398569691）；ADR-0087 D9 的整包操作数已随 #26766 落地，按 6439038287 的「同意」改写 changeset 标记后门禁转绿。
- 风险与回滚：npm 外部使用者未实测（changeset 的 BREAKING 说明覆盖）；回滚即 revert 本 PR。`check-empty-changeset` 故意红着：合并 main 后待发的 26080 changeset 列着已删除的包，本 PR 删掉那一行，需要你确认。
- 先看：`.changeset/25921-retire-plugin-ai.md`（整包标记与 FROM 行）、`.changeset/26080-readme-contributing-links.md`（删掉的一行）、`ui/packages/types/src/zod/ai.zod.ts`（拒收 arm 与墓碑）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`，预期 exit 0，并打印 `verified: @object-ui/plugin-ai#* (package, ui/packages/plugin-ai/package.json)`。
- 需要你做的：确认删掉 26080 changeset 里 `'@object-ui/plugin-ai': patch` 这一行（包已删除，留着会让 `changeset version` 失败），然后按 Tier H 批准（改动超过 3,000 行）。

## What changes

- **Package deleted.** `ui/packages/plugin-ai/**`, its `pnpm-lock.yaml` importer and its `ui/vitest.config.mts` alias.
- **Release group.** Its entry leaves the fixed group in `.changeset/config.json`.
- **Locale packs.** The `ai.*` block (`ai.nlQuery.*`, `ai.formAssist.*`, `ai.recommendations.*`) is deleted from all ten packs.
- **Types tombstones (ruling A).** `ui/packages/types/src/ai.ts` keeps its nine exported names as `@deprecated` `never` aliases with the remedy, and `AnySchema` loses the three node members. In `zod/ai.zod.ts` the three arms become `retiredNodeType()` refusal arms, listed in `AnyComponentSchema` and not exported from the barrel. The eight published zod names stay exported as `@deprecated` `z.never()` schemas that accept nothing; when they leave the published face is #25912's sunset rule.
- **CLI.** `known-schema-types.ts` loses the three keys.
- **Docs.** `ui/content/docs/plugins/plugin-ai.mdx` and its `meta.json` entry. The package-table row now lives in the root `CONTRIBUTING.md` (main folded `ui/README.md` into it), and is removed there.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/25921-retire-plugin-ai.md`: `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/cli` minor, BREAKING. The ADR-0087 marker is `not-required (runtime-export-retired @object-ui/plugin-ai#*)`, and the three per-export FROM lines are one line naming the package (`FROM` the package `TO nothing`, the TO text kept).
- **Pending changeset corrected.** `.changeset/26080-readme-contributing-links.md` (landed on main after #26365 was built) listed `'@object-ui/plugin-ai': patch`. A pending changeset naming a deleted package breaks `changeset version`, so that one line is deleted. Nothing else in that note changes.

**Follow-up, not here (Tier H):** `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` and `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` still name `@object-ui/plugin-ai`. They are governed, so they go in a separate PR after this one.

### Forced test edits (each follows the deletion, none relaxes a check)

- New pin `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/plugin-ai-retired-25921.test.ts`: compile-time absence from `AnySchema` and the `never` names, the named refusal for each literal with its remedy, a firing control (`button` still accepted), a generic-path control for an unknown literal, and the eight zod names accepting nothing.
- Deleted, because their subject left with the package: `ai-zod-arms-10859.test.ts`, `ai-node-faces-agree-10874.test.ts`, `ai-zero-read-members-retired-8178.test.ts` and the package's own test files.
- `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, `arm-named-export-8784.test.ts`, `any-component-emit-headroom-11573.test.ts`, `component-docs-retired-handler-keys-7340.test.ts`, `content-channel-family-d-9256.test.ts`, `content-channel-parser-tier-clause-10928.test.ts`, `silence-clause-parser-tier-closure-10981.test.ts`, `ai-insights-retired-8800.test.ts`: rows and counts that named the three nodes, as in #26365.
- `ui/packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts`: the "armed" case becomes a by-name refusal case with a generic-path control. `ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` follows: the entries that read the plugin-ai README go, and so does the `notRead: ['packages/cli/README.md']` that main added to the cli entry (the scanner found that path only through the plugin-ai README's bare `README.md` segment, so the audit reports it stale once the README is gone).
- Deletions-only ledgers lose their plugin-ai rows: `clickableNonControlCensus-13461`, `iconOnlyButtonCensus-12143`, `runner-package-test-entry-3746`, `doc-version-claims`; `percent-storage-callers-11475` loses its plugin-ai exclusion set.
- `console-vite-alias-closure-4925.test.ts`: its named negative control is now `@object-ui/cli`. `select-type-check-scope.test.ts`: its leaf-package fixture moves to `plugin-markdown`.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/package-files-exist.test.ts`: main's side taken on merge. #26576 moved both floors to the shared published-package constant, which a retirement does not move, so #26365's hand-lowered floors are gone.

## Tests

<details><summary>Readings at head 7040d92f78 (merge of main acc9c57d0a)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types packages/i18n packages/cli`: 511 files passed, 12453 tests passed, 13 skipped.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` at 53dfa40886: 178 files, 1 failed (`markdown-test-inputs.test.ts`, the stale `notRead` above), 5017 passed. Fixed in 7040d92f78; that file rerun: 17 / 17 passed.
- `type-check` of `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/cli` (script names echoed): exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:scripts`: exit 0.
- Build: `turbo run build` with the root script's filters, 115 / 115 tasks.
- Ablation of the new pin (from #26365, its test unchanged here): `RetiredNLQueryNodeSchema` deleted from `AnyComponentSchema` turns exactly the two `nl-query` cases red (2 failed, 15 passed of 17); restored, blob equals HEAD.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR-0087 predicate 2 and two code-string mentions.** Classified with the gate's own `maskComments` and `packageReference`, `ui/packages/types/src/zod/ai.zod.ts` at this head names `@object-ui/plugin-ai` in code twice: both are the refusal remedy strings of the retired node arms (the text ruling A asks for). Every other mention in `ui/packages/types/src/zod/*.zod.ts` is a comment. Predicate 2 judges the package at the merge base, where all four mentions on main are comments, so the gate is green. The seat ruled to proceed as is.
- **Tracker number in runtime strings.** Those refusal strings carry `(objectstack#25921)`. AGENTS.md says runtime strings carry no tracker number (`check:doc-authoring`); that gate is not in this diff's derived set and nothing derived refused it, so the strings are left as built.
- **`check-empty-changeset` red by design.** It refuses the one-line correction of `.changeset/26080-readme-contributing-links.md` (DELIBERATE CORRECTION class). The gate stays red until a maintainer confirms the correction on this PR.
- External npm consumers of `@object-ui/plugin-ai`: NOT MEASURED; the changeset carries the FROM / TO line.
- Leftover pre-merge notes under `ui/.changeset/` still name `@object-ui/plugin-ai`; the root changesets config does not read that directory (`ui/AGENTS.md`), so they are untouched.
- Unrelated `plugin-ai` mentions under `packages/spec`, `packages/metadata-protocol` and `scripts/check-service-providers.mjs` name the platform's own AI service plugin, not this package.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0, `verified: @object-ui/plugin-ai#* (package, ui/packages/plugin-ai/package.json)`.
- `pnpm changeset status`: exit 0.
- Lockfile: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exit 0 after the merge, and `pnpm install --lockfile-only` leaves `pnpm-lock.yaml` byte-identical (0 `plugin-ai` mentions).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 56 derived, 56 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Red: `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` (by design, above) and the first `vitest run scripts/` (fixed, above). `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` exit 3 or 1 before the build and 0 after it.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: 0 anchored files in the change set.
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate (TIER_DEFAULT). Changed lines 7568 (+439 / −7129): over the 3,000-line threshold, so this lands by an authorized approval.
- Full dogfood on the final head: reading goes in the card's os-dev report.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (CI-owned run).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
